name: Hollowmere
author: The Lantern example
description: Well formed, and wrong in four ways resolution can only warn about: an extension aimed at a pack that is not loaded, an override of content that is not loaded, a talent nothing defines, and a table with an overlap and a gap. Load it to watch all five warnings and none of them stop it.

classes.name: Mere-guide
classes.text: Walks ahead of everyone else over the drowned roads, because they know which stones still carry weight.

items.name: Mere lantern
items.text: A shuttered lantern that burns wet. It overrides a lantern from Wintergloom, a pack this repository does not ship: a supplement that is turned off, or a reference typed wrong, reads exactly like this. Nothing defines the target, so the app warns, keeps this entry at that reference so a sheet holding one still resolves, and loads the rest of the file.

talents.name: Mere-touched
talents.text: Standing water never counts as harsh going for you, and you can tell how deep one is by looking at it.

tables.name: Mere-guide talents

rows.text: Choose a talent from any table the DM has loaded
A band that starts on 3, which the row above already covers
A band that leaves 5 to nobody

tables.text: The overlap and the gap are the point. A lookup answers with the first row covering the number, and shows the number with no row for 5.
